c1-27-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Cause of an Illness
c1-27-01.scenario: You have read about an illness in a hospital. Károly asks what caused it.
c1-27-01.prompt: Tell Károly what caused the illness.
cues: Say what happened to the patients
c1-27-01.target: A kórokozók átvitele következtében sok anya megbetegedett.
c1-27-01.english: As a result of the transfer of pathogens, many mothers fell ill.
c1-27-01.canDo: I can say what caused an infection with *miatt*, *emiatt* and *következtében*.

c1-27-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Rule That Prevents Infection
c1-27-02.scenario: You have read about a hospital rule. Károly asks what the rule is for.
c1-27-02.prompt: Tell Károly what the rule does.
c1-27-02.target: A kézmosást előíró szabály megelőzi a fertőzést.
c1-27-02.english: The rule that prescribes handwashing prevents infection.
c1-27-02.canDo: I can describe a measure with a participle before the noun (*a kézmosást előíró*, *a fertőzést megelőző*, *a halálozást csökkentő*).

c1-27-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Belief and Evidence
c1-27-03.scenario: Károly asks what doctors once believed about the cause of the illness.
c1-27-03.prompt: Tell Károly what doctors believed and what the numbers showed.
c1-27-03.target: A miazma-elmélet szerint a rossz levegő okozza a kórt; ezzel szemben a számok a kezekre mutattak.
c1-27-03.english: According to the miasma theory bad air causes the disease; in contrast, the numbers pointed to the hands.
c1-27-03.canDo: I can set an old belief against the evidence with *szerint … ezzel szemben*, *éppen ellenkezőleg* and *mindazonáltal*.

c1-27-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Duty of the Doctor
c1-27-04.scenario: Károly asks what a doctor owes a patient.
c1-27-04.prompt: Tell Károly one duty of a doctor.
c1-27-04.target: Az orvos köteles beismerni a hibáját.
c1-27-04.english: The doctor is obliged to admit his mistake.
c1-27-04.canDo: I can say what a doctor or a hospital is obliged to do with *köteles* and *kell*.

c1-27-05.title: Communicative Challenge: How Big Was the Change
c1-27-05.scenario: You have read about handwashing in a Vienna hospital. Károly asks how mortality changed.
c1-27-05.prompt: Tell Károly how big the change was.
cues: Say how big the change was
c1-27-05.target: A kézmosás bevezetése után a halálozás jelentősen csökkent.
c1-27-05.english: After handwashing was introduced, mortality fell considerably.
c1-27-05.canDo: I can say how big a change was with a degree adverb (*számottevően*, *drasztikusan*, *csaknem*).

c1-27-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What Semmelweis Found
c1-27-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you to sum up in two sentences what Semmelweis Ignác found.
c1-27-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what Semmelweis concluded and what changed.
c1-27-consolidation.target: Semmelweis Ignác arra következtetett, hogy az orvosok a kezükön viszik át a fertőzést. A kézmosás után a halálozás jelentősen csökkent.
c1-27-consolidation.english: Semmelweis Ignác concluded that the doctors carry the infection on their hands. After handwashing, mortality fell considerably.
c1-27-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for disease, prevention, dogma and medical ethics.
